entry.name: GeM Startup Runway
entry.summary: Dedicated marketplace category on the Government e-Marketplace letting startups list products and services and sell to government buyers, with relaxed norms (no prior turnover or experience, no earnest money deposit). Launched 19 Feb 2019 (with SWAYATT); Startup Runway 2.0 is now live and no longer requires DPIIT certification. 15,665 startups registered on GeM; ₹9,512.07 crore GMV processed. 13 startup sub-sectors listed (AI, fintech, health and life sciences, clean tech and more).
entry.value: Government marketplace access; relaxed norms for startups

provenance.evidence: Verified 2026-11-21 from the GeM Startup Runway 2.0 page and PIB launch release; crawl-20261121-partners-03 candidate #122.
